summary: Always-on mode now changes plain-text submission semantics and tool/prompt availability.

findings.message: `packages/coding-agent/src/tui/tui-renderer.ts` now routes plain text in `/always-on` through `alwaysOnService.submit({ kind: "immediate", ... })` before normal chat validation.
Mode entry adds primitive mode-scoped tools `always_on_snapshot` and `always_on_submit`, and mode exit restores the pre-mode tool/prompt surface.
A shared `executeAlwaysOnRunWithMu()` helper now lives in `packages/coding-agent/src/always-on/execute-run.ts` so the TUI and CLI can share execution wiring without shelling out.
